subject: Private deployment: orchestrated patch window, rollback authority & fall-through scripts
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@northbridgehealth.com>, Rackspace Support <support@rackspace.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposed maintenance window + pin policy for NBH private fleet

Team —

Following our dry run last week, I want to lock a short maintenance window and the exact rollback authority chain for Northbridge Health (NBH) private deployment. High-level proposal below; please flag any technical or compliance blockers.

- Target window: Mon 2026-12-06 01:00-04:00 UTC (2.5h runway + 30m verification)
- Pinning policy: pin control-plane to v2026.11.1; data-plane nodes will be allowed a staged bump to v2026.11.3 during canary wave only.
- Canary cadence: 2% fleet -> 10% -> 30% -> 100% with 20m observation between waves.
- Rollback triggers: 5xx > 1% sustained for 10m, tokenization regressions on known evals, KV cache eviction > baseline by 30%.
- Rollback authority: on-call Ops (Soojin) has emergency rollback permission; Engineering Lead (Karthik) must sign-off for staged unapplied pins; Customer contact (Amanda) will be notified at each stage.

Attachments: draft runbook, dryrun results, fallback scripts (stubs).

Ask: Karthik/Soojin — confirm that pinned control-plane plan is implementable in this window and that the canary cadence fits current autoscaling behavior. Jonas — I need a short list of telemetry queries we'll watch (error-rate, tail-latency p95/p99, memory pressure). Amanda — is the window OK on your end?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Technical Program Manager — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: nbh_patch_runbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 52KB); dryrun-results-20261125.csv (CSV, 8KB); fallback-scripts.tar.gz (archive, 120KB)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed maintenance window + pin policy for NBH private fleet

Neha — thanks for the plan, concise and sensible. A few technical considerations/questions:

1) Control-plane pin: are we planning a DB migration as part of v2026.11.1? If yes, we need an extra 30m and a preflight check on schema compatibility.
2) KV cache behavior: during the dry run we saw a ~12% spike in redis evictions on canaries. Suggest we tighten the rollback threshold to 20% for the first wave and 30% thereafter.
3) Canary nodes: confirm that 2% means node-count-based (e.g., 2 nodes) not percentage of requests — we need node-based so customers with small fleets aren't harmed.

I can be on the bridge for the rollout. I want engineering approval before we allow auto-bump to v2026.11.3 on the data-plane; prefer manual promotion for the first full wave.

Karthik
Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

> On Fri, 27 Nov 2026 at 09:12, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Team —
> > Following our dry run last week, I want to lock a short maintenance window...

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@northbridgehealth.com>, Rackspace Support <support@rackspace.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposed maintenance window + pin policy for NBH private fleet

Neha/Karthik — quick ops checklist and run-of-show notes:

- Prechecks (T-72h): verify DR images, config drift check, backup snapshot (s3://nbh-backups/20261127), and alert routing tests.
- Dryrun summary: see attached CSV — canaries had two transient 502 bursts coincident with KV GC in one zone. We have a small mitigation patch to push to the fallback-scripts bundle that disables aggressive GC for 30m post-deploy.
- Bridge roles: Ops bridge lead (Soojin), runtime eng triage (Karthik), customer comms (Neha), rackspace liaison (Rackspace Support).
- Abort criteria: 2 consecutive waves failing any rollback trigger -> immediate freeze + rollback.
- Post-rollback: automatic pin to last known-good image and a 4h cool-down before re-attempt.

I will prepare a minimal runbook summary (1-page) and the set of metrics queries for Jonas. Also copying Rackspace for validation of network-level maintenance windows (they may need a short ACL change).

Soojin
Senior SRE — Private Ops
Redwood Inference

> On Fri, 27 Nov 2026 at 11:05, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Neha — thanks for the plan...

From: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed maintenance window + pin policy for NBH private fleet

Hi Neha,

The proposed window 2026-12-06 01:00-04:00 UTC works for NBH operations — low traffic overnight. A couple of asks from our side:

- Please ensure a 30-minute notification before each canary wave and an SMS escalation if we hit rollback.
- We need assurance that database migrations (if any) have read-only fallback for 60m in case of partial schema application. We cannot have writes rejected silently for production workflows.
- Can you share the minimal runbook Soojin mentioned? We want our on-call engineer to have the simple checklist.

Thanks for coordinating — Amanda
Senior Cloud Architect
Northbridge Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Amanda Liu <amanda.liu@northbridgehealth.com>, Rackspace Support <support@rackspace.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed maintenance window + pin policy for NBH private fleet

Thanks everyone — incorporating feedback and locking the plan. Quick summary of decisions and action owners: 

- Window confirmed: 2026-12-06 01:00-04:00 UTC (Neha to send calendar invites, Amanda to confirm on-call).
- Control-plane DB migration: NONE in this ship (we delay schema changes to 2026-12-20). Control-plane upgrade is config+binary only (Karthik confirms).
- Canary thresholds adjusted: first wave KV eviction threshold lowered to 20% (Soojin) with 30% for later waves. Node-count based canaries.
- Rollback flow: immediate freeze + automated pin to last-known-good image; Soojin has emergency rollback permission; Karthik to approve manual promotions.
- Comms: 30-min SMS/Slack notification before each wave (Neha to coordinate).
- Artifacts: attached runbook v1, dryrun CSV, fallback scripts tarball. Jonas — please add the telemetry queries below to the shared dashboard before Wed 2026-12-02.

Telemetry quick-list (for Jonas to add):
- control_plane.error_rate per minute
- data_plane.p95_latency, data_plane.p99_latency
- redis.evictions per minute (zone split)
- kv_cache.hit_ratio
- host.memory.used_percent

I'll create the bridge calendar invite and post the runbook link to the NBH project drive. If there are no further objections by EOD Wed 2026-12-02 we'll treat this locked.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Technical Program Manager — Private Deployments
Redwood Inference
